tools.name: population_daily_compile
tools.description: Explain the same daily User request without computing members. Parse single plan_json carrier as ossie-daily-user-set-plan-v1: actual bound observation projection plus C++ date/product/distinct-user-day/calendar-count/sort/complete-JSON logical steps. Internal configuration and input Prepare occur, not projection execution/fetch; no physical plan, final output binding, replayable SQL or execution-success guarantee. Compile may succeed while execution exceeds its result budget. Separate calls after operator reload can bind different snapshots; compare hashes. Same exact request_json contract as population_daily_users, max16KiB; complete plan max1MiB. Unknown outer arguments are ignored; upstream may coerce non-string values, so clients must send Strings. All scope belongs in request_json. This server exposes only the two daily tools, with no import/reload/arbitrary SQL.

tools.name: population_daily_users
tools.description: Return the complete set of raw User IDs with at least one TRUE qualified observation on every requested natural calendar day, inclusive endpoints. Discover the exact qualified concept and current formal rule first. Product may change by day; FALSE/NULL does not cancel TRUE, missing has no witness. request_json is a JSON-encoded object with exactly start_date, end_date, products. Dates YYYY-MM-DD, max366 days; products is {"mode":"all"} or {"mode":"subset","values":["X"]}, max64 raw nonempty unique strings/max256 UTF-8 bytes each. Request max16KiB, internal full result max1MiB; failure never truncates or substitutes count-only. Parse single result_json carrier as ossie-daily-user-set-result-v1. Count is integer text; raw IDs ordered by UTF-8 bytes; no paging. Compare scope, formal rule and snapshot hashes. Unknown outer arguments are ignored; upstream may coerce non-string values, so clients must send Strings. Scope belongs only inside request_json. This tool does not expose generic objects/metrics, states, historical rules, as-of, windows or arbitrary SQL.

tools.name: population_daily_compile
tools.description: Explain the same daily User request without computing members. Parse single plan_json carrier as ossie-daily-user-set-plan-v1: actual bound observation projection plus C++ date/product/distinct-user-day/calendar-count/sort/complete-JSON logical steps. Internal configuration and input Prepare occur, not projection execution/fetch; no physical plan, final output binding, replayable SQL or execution-success guarantee. Compile may succeed while execution exceeds its result budget. Separate calls after operator reload can bind different snapshots; compare hashes. Same exact request_json contract as population_daily_users, max16KiB; complete plan max1MiB. Unknown outer arguments are ignored; upstream may coerce non-string values, so clients must send Strings. All scope belongs in request_json. This server exposes only the two daily tools, with no import/reload/arbitrary SQL.

tools.name: population_daily_users
tools.description: Return the complete set of raw User IDs with at least one TRUE qualified observation on every requested natural calendar day, inclusive endpoints. Discover the exact qualified concept and current formal rule first. Product may change by day; FALSE/NULL does not cancel TRUE, missing has no witness. request_json is a JSON-encoded object with exactly start_date, end_date, products. Dates YYYY-MM-DD, max366 days; products is {"mode":"all"} or {"mode":"subset","values":["X"]}, max64 raw nonempty unique strings/max256 UTF-8 bytes each. Request max16KiB, internal full result max1MiB; failure never truncates or substitutes count-only. Parse single result_json carrier as ossie-daily-user-set-result-v1. Count is integer text; raw IDs ordered by UTF-8 bytes; no paging. Compare scope, formal rule and snapshot hashes. Unknown outer arguments are ignored; upstream may coerce non-string values, so clients must send Strings. Scope belongs only inside request_json. This tool does not expose generic objects/metrics, states, historical rules, as-of, windows or arbitrary SQL.

plan.qualified_projection_sql: SELECT observations.user_id, observations.ds, observations.product FROM "system".main._ossie_snapshot_rows() AS observations WHERE (observations.classification_value >= 10)
limitations: Projection SQL alone does not include the C++ scope and cross-day reduction
Internal frozen AST dependency prevents ordinary SQL replay
Compile does not calculate members, validate success result size or ensure execution completion
Separate calls can bind different snapshots after reload

tools.name: population_daily_compile
tools.description: Explain the same daily User request without computing members. Parse single plan_json carrier as ossie-daily-user-set-plan-v1: actual bound observation projection plus C++ date/product/distinct-user-day/calendar-count/sort/complete-JSON logical steps. Internal configuration and input Prepare occur, not projection execution/fetch; no physical plan, final output binding, replayable SQL or execution-success guarantee. Compile may succeed while execution exceeds its result budget. Separate calls after operator reload can bind different snapshots; compare hashes. Same exact request_json contract as population_daily_users, max16KiB; complete plan max1MiB. Unknown outer arguments are ignored; upstream may coerce non-string values, so clients must send Strings. All scope belongs in request_json. This server exposes only the two daily tools, with no import/reload/arbitrary SQL.

tools.name: population_daily_users
tools.description: Return the complete set of raw User IDs with at least one TRUE qualified observation on every requested natural calendar day, inclusive endpoints. Discover the exact qualified concept and current formal rule first. Product may change by day; FALSE/NULL does not cancel TRUE, missing has no witness. request_json is a JSON-encoded object with exactly start_date, end_date, products. Dates YYYY-MM-DD, max366 days; products is {"mode":"all"} or {"mode":"subset","values":["X"]}, max64 raw nonempty unique strings/max256 UTF-8 bytes each. Request max16KiB, internal full result max1MiB; failure never truncates or substitutes count-only. Parse single result_json carrier as ossie-daily-user-set-result-v1. Count is integer text; raw IDs ordered by UTF-8 bytes; no paging. Compare scope, formal rule and snapshot hashes. Unknown outer arguments are ignored; upstream may coerce non-string values, so clients must send Strings. Scope belongs only inside request_json. This tool does not expose generic objects/metrics, states, historical rules, as-of, windows or arbitrary SQL.

Parse single plan_json carrier as ossie-daily-user-set-plan-v1: actual bound observation projection plus C++ date/product/distinct-user-day/calendar-count/sort/complete-JSON logical steps. Internal configuration and input Prepare occur, not projection execution/fetch; no physical plan, final output binding, replayable SQL or execution-success guarantee. Compile may succeed while execution exceeds its result budget. Separate calls after operator reload can bind different snapshots; compare hashes. Same exact request_json contract as population_daily_users, max16KiB; complete plan max1MiB. Unknown outer arguments are ignored; upstream may coerce non-string values, so clients must send Strings. All scope belongs in request_json. This server exposes only the two daily tools, with no import/reload/arbitrary SQL.

tools.name: population_daily_users
tools.description: Return the complete set of raw User IDs with at least one TRUE qualified observation on every requested natural calendar day, inclusive endpoints. Discover the exact qualified concept and current formal rule first. Product may change by day; FALSE/NULL does not cancel TRUE, missing has no witness. request_json is a JSON-encoded object with exactly start_date, end_date, products. Dates YYYY-MM-DD, max366 days; products is {"mode":"all"} or {"mode":"subset","values":["X"]}, max64 raw nonempty unique strings/max256 UTF-8 bytes each. Request max16KiB, internal full result max1MiB; failure never truncates or substitutes count-only. Parse single result_json carrier as ossie-daily-user-set-result-v1. Count is integer text; raw IDs ordered by UTF-8 bytes; no paging. Compare scope, formal rule and snapshot hashes. Unknown outer arguments are ignored; upstream may coerce non-string values, so clients must send Strings. Scope belongs only inside request_json. This tool does not expose generic objects/metrics, states, historical rules, as-of, windows or arbitrary SQL.

tools.name: population_daily_compile
tools.description: Explain the same daily User request without computing members. Parse single plan_json carrier as ossie-daily-user-set-plan-v1: actual bound observation projection plus C++ date/product/distinct-user-day/calendar-count/sort/complete-JSON logical steps. Internal configuration and input Prepare occur, not projection execution/fetch; no physical plan, final output binding, replayable SQL or execution-success guarantee. Compile may succeed while execution exceeds its result budget. Separate calls after operator reload can bind different snapshots; compare hashes. Same exact request_json contract as population_daily_users, max16KiB; complete plan max1MiB. Unknown outer arguments are ignored; upstream may coerce non-string values, so clients must send Strings. All scope belongs in request_json. This server exposes only the two daily tools, with no import/reload/arbitrary SQL.

tools.name: population_daily_users
tools.description: Return the complete set of raw User IDs with at least one TRUE qualified observation on every requested natural calendar day, inclusive endpoints. Discover the exact qualified concept and current formal rule first. Product may change by day; FALSE/NULL does not cancel TRUE, missing has no witness. request_json is a JSON-encoded object with exactly start_date, end_date, products. Dates YYYY-MM-DD, max366 days; products is {"mode":"all"} or {"mode":"subset","values":["X"]}, max64 raw nonempty unique strings/max256 UTF-8 bytes each. Request max16KiB, internal full result max1MiB; failure never truncates or substitutes count-only. Parse single result_json carrier as ossie-daily-user-set-result-v1. Count is integer text; raw IDs ordered by UTF-8 bytes; no paging. Compare scope, formal rule and snapshot hashes. Unknown outer arguments are ignored; upstream may coerce non-string values, so clients must send Strings. Scope belongs only inside request_json. This tool does not expose generic objects/metrics, states, historical rules, as-of, windows or arbitrary SQL.

tools.name: population_daily_compile
tools.description: Explain the same daily User request without computing members. Parse single plan_json carrier as ossie-daily-user-set-plan-v1: actual bound observation projection plus C++ date/product/distinct-user-day/calendar-count/sort/complete-JSON logical steps. Internal configuration and input Prepare occur, not projection execution/fetch; no physical plan, final output binding, replayable SQL or execution-success guarantee. Compile may succeed while execution exceeds its result budget. Separate calls after operator reload can bind different snapshots; compare hashes. Same exact request_json contract as population_daily_users, max16KiB; complete plan max1MiB. Unknown outer arguments are ignored; upstream may coerce non-string values, so clients must send Strings. All scope belongs in request_json. This server exposes only the two daily tools, with no import/reload/arbitrary SQL.

tools.name: population_daily_users
tools.description: Return the complete set of raw User IDs with at least one TRUE qualified observation on every requested natural calendar day, inclusive endpoints. Discover the exact qualified concept and current formal rule first. Product may change by day; FALSE/NULL does not cancel TRUE, missing has no witness. request_json is a JSON-encoded object with exactly start_date, end_date, products. Dates YYYY-MM-DD, max366 days; products is {"mode":"all"} or {"mode":"subset","values":["X"]}, max64 raw nonempty unique strings/max256 UTF-8 bytes each. Request max16KiB, internal full result max1MiB; failure never truncates or substitutes count-only. Parse single result_json carrier as ossie-daily-user-set-result-v1. Count is integer text; raw IDs ordered by UTF-8 bytes; no paging. Compare scope, formal rule and snapshot hashes. Unknown outer arguments are ignored; upstream may coerce non-string values, so clients must send Strings. Scope belongs only inside request_json. This tool does not expose generic objects/metrics, states, historical rules, as-of, windows or arbitrary SQL.

tools.description: Explain the same daily User request without computing members. Parse single plan_json carrier as ossie-daily-user-set-plan-v1: actual bound observation projection plus C++ date/product/distinct-user-day/calendar-count/sort/complete-JSON logical steps. Internal configuration and input Prepare occur, not projection execution/fetch; no physical plan, final output binding, replayable SQL or execution-success guarantee. Compile may succeed while execution exceeds its result budget. Separate calls after operator reload can bind different snapshots; compare hashes. Same exact request_json contract as population_daily_users, max16KiB; complete plan max1MiB. Unknown outer arguments are ignored; upstream may coerce non-string values, so clients must send Strings. All scope belongs in request_json. This server exposes only the two daily tools, with no import/reload/arbitrary SQL.

tools.name: population_daily_users
tools.description: Return the complete set of raw User IDs with at least one TRUE qualified observation on every requested natural calendar day, inclusive endpoints. Discover the exact qualified concept and current formal rule first. Product may change by day; FALSE/NULL does not cancel TRUE, missing has no witness. request_json is a JSON-encoded object with exactly start_date, end_date, products. Dates YYYY-MM-DD, max366 days; products is {"mode":"all"} or {"mode":"subset","values":["X"]}, max64 raw nonempty unique strings/max256 UTF-8 bytes each. Request max16KiB, internal full result max1MiB; failure never truncates or substitutes count-only. Parse single result_json carrier as ossie-daily-user-set-result-v1. Count is integer text; raw IDs ordered by UTF-8 bytes; no paging. Compare scope, formal rule and snapshot hashes. Unknown outer arguments are ignored; upstream may coerce non-string values, so clients must send Strings. Scope belongs only inside request_json. This tool does not expose generic objects/metrics, states, historical rules, as-of, windows or arbitrary SQL.

tools.name: population_daily_compile
tools.description: Explain the same daily User request without computing members. Parse single plan_json carrier as ossie-daily-user-set-plan-v1: actual bound observation projection plus C++ date/product/distinct-user-day/calendar-count/sort/complete-JSON logical steps. Internal configuration and input Prepare occur, not projection execution/fetch; no physical plan, final output binding, replayable SQL or execution-success guarantee. Compile may succeed while execution exceeds its result budget. Separate calls after operator reload can bind different snapshots; compare hashes. Same exact request_json contract as population_daily_users, max16KiB; complete plan max1MiB. Unknown outer arguments are ignored; upstream may coerce non-string values, so clients must send Strings. All scope belongs in request_json. This server exposes only the two daily tools, with no import/reload/arbitrary SQL.

tools.name: population_daily_users
tools.description: Return the complete set of raw User IDs with at least one TRUE qualified observation on every requested natural calendar day, inclusive endpoints. Discover the exact qualified concept and current formal rule first. Product may change by day; FALSE/NULL does not cancel TRUE, missing has no witness. request_json is a JSON-encoded object with exactly start_date, end_date, products. Dates YYYY-MM-DD, max366 days; products is {"mode":"all"} or {"mode":"subset","values":["X"]}, max64 raw nonempty unique strings/max256 UTF-8 bytes each. Request max16KiB, internal full result max1MiB; failure never truncates or substitutes count-only. Parse single result_json carrier as ossie-daily-user-set-result-v1. Count is integer text; raw IDs ordered by UTF-8 bytes; no paging. Compare scope, formal rule and snapshot hashes. Unknown outer arguments are ignored; upstream may coerce non-string values, so clients must send Strings. Scope belongs only inside request_json. This tool does not expose generic objects/metrics, states, historical rules, as-of, windows or arbitrary SQL.

tools.name: population_daily_compile
tools.description: Explain the same daily User request without computing members. Parse single plan_json carrier as ossie-daily-user-set-plan-v1: actual bound observation projection plus C++ date/product/distinct-user-day/calendar-count/sort/complete-JSON logical steps. Internal configuration and input Prepare occur, not projection execution/fetch; no physical plan, final output binding, replayable SQL or execution-success guarantee. Compile may succeed while execution exceeds its result budget. Separate calls after operator reload can bind different snapshots; compare hashes. Same exact request_json contract as population_daily_users, max16KiB; complete plan max1MiB. Unknown outer arguments are ignored; upstream may coerce non-string values, so clients must send Strings. All scope belongs in request_json. This server exposes only the two daily tools, with no import/reload/arbitrary SQL.

tools.name: population_daily_users
tools.description: Return the complete set of raw User IDs with at least one TRUE qualified observation on every requested natural calendar day, inclusive endpoints. Discover the exact qualified concept and current formal rule first. Product may change by day; FALSE/NULL does not cancel TRUE, missing has no witness. request_json is a JSON-encoded object with exactly start_date, end_date, products. Dates YYYY-MM-DD, max366 days; products is {"mode":"all"} or {"mode":"subset","values":["X"]}, max64 raw nonempty unique strings/max256 UTF-8 bytes each. Request max16KiB, internal full result max1MiB; failure never truncates or substitutes count-only. Parse single result_json carrier as ossie-daily-user-set-result-v1. Count is integer text; raw IDs ordered by UTF-8 bytes; no paging. Compare scope, formal rule and snapshot hashes. Unknown outer arguments are ignored; upstream may coerce non-string values, so clients must send Strings. Scope belongs only inside request_json. This tool does not expose generic objects/metrics, states, historical rules, as-of, windows or arbitrary SQL.

tools.description: Explain the same daily User request without computing members. Parse single plan_json carrier as ossie-daily-user-set-plan-v1: actual bound observation projection plus C++ date/product/distinct-user-day/calendar-count/sort/complete-JSON logical steps. Internal configuration and input Prepare occur, not projection execution/fetch; no physical plan, final output binding, replayable SQL or execution-success guarantee. Compile may succeed while execution exceeds its result budget. Separate calls after operator reload can bind different snapshots; compare hashes. Same exact request_json contract as population_daily_users, max16KiB; complete plan max1MiB. Unknown outer arguments are ignored; upstream may coerce non-string values, so clients must send Strings. All scope belongs in request_json. This server exposes only the two daily tools, with no import/reload/arbitrary SQL.

tools.name: population_daily_users
tools.description: Return the complete set of raw User IDs with at least one TRUE qualified observation on every requested natural calendar day, inclusive endpoints. Discover the exact qualified concept and current formal rule first. Product may change by day; FALSE/NULL does not cancel TRUE, missing has no witness. request_json is a JSON-encoded object with exactly start_date, end_date, products. Dates YYYY-MM-DD, max366 days; products is {"mode":"all"} or {"mode":"subset","values":["X"]}, max64 raw nonempty unique strings/max256 UTF-8 bytes each. Request max16KiB, internal full result max1MiB; failure never truncates or substitutes count-only. Parse single result_json carrier as ossie-daily-user-set-result-v1. Count is integer text; raw IDs ordered by UTF-8 bytes; no paging. Compare scope, formal rule and snapshot hashes. Unknown outer arguments are ignored; upstream may coerce non-string values, so clients must send Strings. Scope belongs only inside request_json. This tool does not expose generic objects/metrics, states, historical rules, as-of, windows or arbitrary SQL.

tools.name: population_daily_compile
tools.description: Explain the same daily User request without computing members. Parse single plan_json carrier as ossie-daily-user-set-plan-v1: actual bound observation projection plus C++ date/product/distinct-user-day/calendar-count/sort/complete-JSON logical steps. Internal configuration and input Prepare occur, not projection execution/fetch; no physical plan, final output binding, replayable SQL or execution-success guarantee. Compile may succeed while execution exceeds its result budget. Separate calls after operator reload can bind different snapshots; compare hashes. Same exact request_json contract as population_daily_users, max16KiB; complete plan max1MiB. Unknown outer arguments are ignored; upstream may coerce non-string values, so clients must send Strings. All scope belongs in request_json. This server exposes only the two daily tools, with no import/reload/arbitrary SQL.

tools.name: population_daily_users
tools.description: Return the complete set of raw User IDs with at least one TRUE qualified observation on every requested natural calendar day, inclusive endpoints. Discover the exact qualified concept and current formal rule first. Product may change by day; FALSE/NULL does not cancel TRUE, missing has no witness. request_json is a JSON-encoded object with exactly start_date, end_date, products. Dates YYYY-MM-DD, max366 days; products is {"mode":"all"} or {"mode":"subset","values":["X"]}, max64 raw nonempty unique strings/max256 UTF-8 bytes each. Request max16KiB, internal full result max1MiB; failure never truncates or substitutes count-only. Parse single result_json carrier as ossie-daily-user-set-result-v1. Count is integer text; raw IDs ordered by UTF-8 bytes; no paging. Compare scope, formal rule and snapshot hashes. Unknown outer arguments are ignored; upstream may coerce non-string values, so clients must send Strings. Scope belongs only inside request_json. This tool does not expose generic objects/metrics, states, historical rules, as-of, windows or arbitrary SQL.

tools.name: population_daily_compile
tools.description: Explain the same daily User request without computing members. Parse single plan_json carrier as ossie-daily-user-set-plan-v1: actual bound observation projection plus C++ date/product/distinct-user-day/calendar-count/sort/complete-JSON logical steps. Internal configuration and input Prepare occur, not projection execution/fetch; no physical plan, final output binding, replayable SQL or execution-success guarantee. Compile may succeed while execution exceeds its result budget. Separate calls after operator reload can bind different snapshots; compare hashes. Same exact request_json contract as population_daily_users, max16KiB; complete plan max1MiB. Unknown outer arguments are ignored; upstream may coerce non-string values, so clients must send Strings. All scope belongs in request_json. This server exposes only the two daily tools, with no import/reload/arbitrary SQL.

tools.name: population_daily_users
tools.description: Return the complete set of raw User IDs with at least one TRUE qualified observation on every requested natural calendar day, inclusive endpoints. Discover the exact qualified concept and current formal rule first. Product may change by day; FALSE/NULL does not cancel TRUE, missing has no witness. request_json is a JSON-encoded object with exactly start_date, end_date, products. Dates YYYY-MM-DD, max366 days; products is {"mode":"all"} or {"mode":"subset","values":["X"]}, max64 raw nonempty unique strings/max256 UTF-8 bytes each. Request max16KiB, internal full result max1MiB; failure never truncates or substitutes count-only. Parse single result_json carrier as ossie-daily-user-set-result-v1. Count is integer text; raw IDs ordered by UTF-8 bytes; no paging. Compare scope, formal rule and snapshot hashes. Unknown outer arguments are ignored; upstream may coerce non-string values, so clients must send Strings. Scope belongs only inside request_json. This tool does not expose generic objects/metrics, states, historical rules, as-of, windows or arbitrary SQL.

tools.description: Explain the same daily User request without computing members. Parse single plan_json carrier as ossie-daily-user-set-plan-v1: actual bound observation projection plus C++ date/product/distinct-user-day/calendar-count/sort/complete-JSON logical steps. Internal configuration and input Prepare occur, not projection execution/fetch; no physical plan, final output binding, replayable SQL or execution-success guarantee. Compile may succeed while execution exceeds its result budget. Separate calls after operator reload can bind different snapshots; compare hashes. Same exact request_json contract as population_daily_users, max16KiB; complete plan max1MiB. Unknown outer arguments are ignored; upstream may coerce non-string values, so clients must send Strings. All scope belongs in request_json. This server exposes only the two daily tools, with no import/reload/arbitrary SQL.

tools.name: population_daily_users
tools.description: Return the complete set of raw User IDs with at least one TRUE qualified observation on every requested natural calendar day, inclusive endpoints. Discover the exact qualified concept and current formal rule first. Product may change by day; FALSE/NULL does not cancel TRUE, missing has no witness. request_json is a JSON-encoded object with exactly start_date, end_date, products. Dates YYYY-MM-DD, max366 days; products is {"mode":"all"} or {"mode":"subset","values":["X"]}, max64 raw nonempty unique strings/max256 UTF-8 bytes each. Request max16KiB, internal full result max1MiB; failure never truncates or substitutes count-only. Parse single result_json carrier as ossie-daily-user-set-result-v1. Count is integer text; raw IDs ordered by UTF-8 bytes; no paging. Compare scope, formal rule and snapshot hashes. Unknown outer arguments are ignored; upstream may coerce non-string values, so clients must send Strings. Scope belongs only inside request_json. This tool does not expose generic objects/metrics, states, historical rules, as-of, windows or arbitrary SQL.

tools.name: population_daily_compile
tools.description: Explain the same daily User request without computing members. Parse single plan_json carrier as ossie-daily-user-set-plan-v1: actual bound observation projection plus C++ date/product/distinct-user-day/calendar-count/sort/complete-JSON logical steps. Internal configuration and input Prepare occur, not projection execution/fetch; no physical plan, final output binding, replayable SQL or execution-success guarantee. Compile may succeed while execution exceeds its result budget. Separate calls after operator reload can bind different snapshots; compare hashes. Same exact request_json contract as population_daily_users, max16KiB; complete plan max1MiB. Unknown outer arguments are ignored; upstream may coerce non-string values, so clients must send Strings. All scope belongs in request_json. This server exposes only the two daily tools, with no import/reload/arbitrary SQL.

tools.name: population_daily_users
tools.description: Return the complete set of raw User IDs with at least one TRUE qualified observation on every requested natural calendar day, inclusive endpoints. Discover the exact qualified concept and current formal rule first. Product may change by day; FALSE/NULL does not cancel TRUE, missing has no witness. request_json is a JSON-encoded object with exactly start_date, end_date, products. Dates YYYY-MM-DD, max366 days; products is {"mode":"all"} or {"mode":"subset","values":["X"]}, max64 raw nonempty unique strings/max256 UTF-8 bytes each. Request max16KiB, internal full result max1MiB; failure never truncates or substitutes count-only. Parse single result_json carrier as ossie-daily-user-set-result-v1. Count is integer text; raw IDs ordered by UTF-8 bytes; no paging. Compare scope, formal rule and snapshot hashes. Unknown outer arguments are ignored; upstream may coerce non-string values, so clients must send Strings. Scope belongs only inside request_json. This tool does not expose generic objects/metrics, states, historical rules, as-of, windows or arbitrary SQL.

tools.name: population_daily_compile
tools.description: Explain the same daily User request without computing members. Parse single plan_json carrier as ossie-daily-user-set-plan-v1: actual bound observation projection plus C++ date/product/distinct-user-day/calendar-count/sort/complete-JSON logical steps. Internal configuration and input Prepare occur, not projection execution/fetch; no physical plan, final output binding, replayable SQL or execution-success guarantee. Compile may succeed while execution exceeds its result budget. Separate calls after operator reload can bind different snapshots; compare hashes. Same exact request_json contract as population_daily_users, max16KiB; complete plan max1MiB. Unknown outer arguments are ignored; upstream may coerce non-string values, so clients must send Strings. All scope belongs in request_json. This server exposes only the two daily tools, with no import/reload/arbitrary SQL.

tools.name: population_daily_users
tools.description: Return the complete set of raw User IDs with at least one TRUE qualified observation on every requested natural calendar day, inclusive endpoints. Discover the exact qualified concept and current formal rule first. Product may change by day; FALSE/NULL does not cancel TRUE, missing has no witness. request_json is a JSON-encoded object with exactly start_date, end_date, products. Dates YYYY-MM-DD, max366 days; products is {"mode":"all"} or {"mode":"subset","values":["X"]}, max64 raw nonempty unique strings/max256 UTF-8 bytes each. Request max16KiB, internal full result max1MiB; failure never truncates or substitutes count-only. Parse single result_json carrier as ossie-daily-user-set-result-v1. Count is integer text; raw IDs ordered by UTF-8 bytes; no paging. Compare scope, formal rule and snapshot hashes. Unknown outer arguments are ignored; upstream may coerce non-string values, so clients must send Strings. Scope belongs only inside request_json. This tool does not expose generic objects/metrics, states, historical rules, as-of, windows or arbitrary SQL.

Parse single plan_json carrier as ossie-daily-user-set-plan-v1: actual bound observation projection plus C++ date/product/distinct-user-day/calendar-count/sort/complete-JSON logical steps. Internal configuration and input Prepare occur, not projection execution/fetch; no physical plan, final output binding, replayable SQL or execution-success guarantee. Compile may succeed while execution exceeds its result budget. Separate calls after operator reload can bind different snapshots; compare hashes. Same exact request_json contract as population_daily_users, max16KiB; complete plan max1MiB. Unknown outer arguments are ignored; upstream may coerce non-string values, so clients must send Strings. All scope belongs in request_json. This server exposes only the two daily tools, with no import/reload/arbitrary SQL.

tools.name: population_daily_users
tools.description: Return the complete set of raw User IDs with at least one TRUE qualified observation on every requested natural calendar day, inclusive endpoints. Discover the exact qualified concept and current formal rule first. Product may change by day; FALSE/NULL does not cancel TRUE, missing has no witness. request_json is a JSON-encoded object with exactly start_date, end_date, products. Dates YYYY-MM-DD, max366 days; products is {"mode":"all"} or {"mode":"subset","values":["X"]}, max64 raw nonempty unique strings/max256 UTF-8 bytes each. Request max16KiB, internal full result max1MiB; failure never truncates or substitutes count-only. Parse single result_json carrier as ossie-daily-user-set-result-v1. Count is integer text; raw IDs ordered by UTF-8 bytes; no paging. Compare scope, formal rule and snapshot hashes. Unknown outer arguments are ignored; upstream may coerce non-string values, so clients must send Strings. Scope belongs only inside request_json. This tool does not expose generic objects/metrics, states, historical rules, as-of, windows or arbitrary SQL.

tools.name: population_daily_compile
tools.description: Explain the same daily User request without computing members. Parse single plan_json carrier as ossie-daily-user-set-plan-v1: actual bound observation projection plus C++ date/product/distinct-user-day/calendar-count/sort/complete-JSON logical steps. Internal configuration and input Prepare occur, not projection execution/fetch; no physical plan, final output binding, replayable SQL or execution-success guarantee. Compile may succeed while execution exceeds its result budget. Separate calls after operator reload can bind different snapshots; compare hashes. Same exact request_json contract as population_daily_users, max16KiB; complete plan max1MiB. Unknown outer arguments are ignored; upstream may coerce non-string values, so clients must send Strings. All scope belongs in request_json. This server exposes only the two daily tools, with no import/reload/arbitrary SQL.

tools.name: population_daily_users
tools.description: Return the complete set of raw User IDs with at least one TRUE qualified observation on every requested natural calendar day, inclusive endpoints. Discover the exact qualified concept and current formal rule first. Product may change by day; FALSE/NULL does not cancel TRUE, missing has no witness. request_json is a JSON-encoded object with exactly start_date, end_date, products. Dates YYYY-MM-DD, max366 days; products is {"mode":"all"} or {"mode":"subset","values":["X"]}, max64 raw nonempty unique strings/max256 UTF-8 bytes each. Request max16KiB, internal full result max1MiB; failure never truncates or substitutes count-only. Parse single result_json carrier as ossie-daily-user-set-result-v1. Count is integer text; raw IDs ordered by UTF-8 bytes; no paging. Compare scope, formal rule and snapshot hashes. Unknown outer arguments are ignored; upstream may coerce non-string values, so clients must send Strings. Scope belongs only inside request_json. This tool does not expose generic objects/metrics, states, historical rules, as-of, windows or arbitrary SQL.
